name: CCI Group Inc
summary: CCI Group, Inc. operates as a holding company for The Hokkoku Bank,Ltd. that provides various financial services in Japan. It operates through the Banking Business and Leasing Business segments. The Banking Business segment provides banking services, credit guarantee related to consumer finance services, credit card services, e-commerce website operation business, servicer business, system development/management /administration services, investment advisory, consulting services, back-office services, and fund administration services. The company was formerly known as Hokkoku Financial Holdings, Inc. and changed its name to CCI Group, Inc. in October 2025. The Leasing Business segment offers leasing services. The company was founded in 1943 and is headquartered in Kanazawa, Japan.
